gloss: pointing out faults; criticism (of a performance, work)

definitions.gloss: pointing out faults; notes, criticism (of a performance or a piece of work)
definitions.explanation: Telling someone what is wrong with their performance, plan or work so that they fix it. From the theater, where the director gives actors notes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駄目出|だめだ}し⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My boss picked my work apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演出家|えんしゅつか}→演出家：15916_enshutsuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駄目出|だめだ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。

⟦{企画書|きかくしょ}→企画書：20593_kikakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{駄目出|だめだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: My proposal was sent back with criticism again and again, but thanks to that it turned out well.

notes:
Often written ダメ{出|だ}し. Very common in workplaces, schools and the entertainment world.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駄目出|だめだ}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to criticize someone's work
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駄目出|だめだ}し⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ / {駄目出|だめだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to have one's work criticized
- {駄目出|だめだ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧: one round of criticism after another

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: criticism in general, often of views or policies; {駄目出|だめだ}し is concrete feedback on a piece of work, meant to improve it
- ⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧: pointing something out, neutral
- {駄目押|だめお}し: something different: making doubly sure, a clinching extra goal
